newsitem.title: USA: US stocks seen opening mixed to higher.
newsitem.headline: US stocks seen opening mixed to higher.

text.p: The New York markets are seen opening mixed to higher on Thursday after recent declines, analysts said.
"Given the fact that Europe and Japan were strong today, I think we'll see a positive opening," said Hildegard Zagorski, an analyst at Prudential Securities.
Analysts said the markets could see a mild rebound after the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell almost 100 points in the last two days.
